plan.notes: Official College of the Canyons 'Diagnostic Medical Sonography AS (Associates GE Track)' program map, marked CATALOG 2026 and 'Updated 7/6/2026 CY 26-27'. Transcribed 2026-10-02 from the official PDF; every course code, title, and unit value copied verbatim. The map publishes nine numbered semesters; the Fourth Semester is a 0-unit planning semester (advisory text only: work on electives, finish Cal-GETC GE, complete the DMS application, study for the TEAS) with Term Total 0 -- it is omitted from sequencing and the remaining semesters keep their official numbers (Fifth through Ninth). Credit ranges seeded at the source's lower bound per convention: First Semester Mathematical Concepts 3-5 units seeded at 3 (dept prefers MATH 103 College Algebra); total_credits 87.5 = sequenced sum at lower bounds (11+13+14+10+13+12+3.5+11), matching the map's printed 'Total Units: 87.5 - 89.5'. 'X or Y' slots use the first-listed code: ENGL-C1000 (or ENGL-C1000H), BIOSCI 201 (or BIOSCI 204), BIOSCI 202 (or BIOSCI 205). Choice slots: Biology Group (Biology 100/101/107, 4 units), Mathematical Concepts (any college-level math, dept prefers MATH 103), Arts or Humanities GE (dept prefers PHILOS 120 Intro to Ethics), Social Science GE (dept prefers SOCI 101, title not printed), Ethnic Studies GE (any approved course). NC. DMS 100 and NC. HLTH 011 are genuine 0-credit recommended electives (required_zero). The map labels semesters 1-3 courses as Prerequisite/Area or Prerequisite/Major but prints no per-course prerequisite text, so prereq arrays are empty and sequencing follows the official placement. Admission to the professional phase (semesters 5-9) requires a separate DMS application and TEAS per the map; see source. VALIDATOR NOTE (2026-10-02): build.py::validate passes this seed on every check except the associate semester-count gate (4-7): the official map genuinely sequences 8 terms (9 numbered semesters; the 0-unit Fourth Semester planning term omitted). Per the zero-error rule the plan was NOT trimmed, merged, or re-labeled to fit the gate -- it is honestly EXCLUDED from shipment pending gate review.
